title: bromus ciliatus var. richardsonii
intro: Bromus ciliatus var. richardsonii, commonly known as Richardson's bromegrass, is a type of grass belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Bromus ciliatus var. richardsonii include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help in soothing sore throats and reducing fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
